MATCH (g:Gene) RETURN g.ENTITY AS gene_entity
List all MeSH entitys.
MATCH (m:MeSH) RETURN m.ENTITY AS mesh_entity
List literature nodes.
MATCH (l:Literature) RETURN l.PMID AS pmid
Find MeSH entitys co-occurring with LINC00954.
MATCH (:Gene {ENTITY:'LINC00954'})-[:CO_OCCURS]-(m:MeSH) RETURN DISTINCT m.ENTITY AS mesh_entity
Which genes co-occur with the MeSH entity Urolithiasis?
MATCH (g:Gene)-[:CO_OCCURS]-(:MeSH {ENTITY:'Urolithiasis'}) RETURN DISTINCT g.ENTITY AS gene_entity
Show literature linked to LINC00954.
MATCH (:Gene {ENTITY:'LINC00954'})-[:HAS_SOURCE]->(l:Literature) RETURN DISTINCT l.PMID AS pmid
Show literature for MeSH Urolithiasis.
MATCH (:MeSH {ENTITY:'Urolithiasis'})-[:HAS_SOURCE]->(l:Literature) RETURN DISTINCT l.PMID AS pmid
Papers whose title contains 'tumor'.
MATCH (l:Literature) WHERE toLower(l.Title) CONTAINS toLower('tumor') RETURN l.PMID AS pmid
LINC00954 papers after 2021.
MATCH (:Gene {ENTITY:'LINC00954'})-[:HAS_SOURCE]->(l:Literature) WHERE l.Year > 2021 RETURN DISTINCT l.PMID AS pmid
LINC00954 papers in BMJ.
MATCH (:Gene {ENTITY:'LINC00954'})-[:HAS_SOURCE]->(l:Literature) WHERE l.Journal = 'BMJ' RETURN DISTINCT l.PMID AS pmid
Count MeSH entitys per gene.
MATCH (g:Gene)-[:CO_OCCURS]-(m:MeSH) RETURN g.ENTITY AS gene_entity, count(DISTINCT m) AS mesh_count
Count genes per MeSH entity.
MATCH (m:MeSH)<-[:CO_OCCURS]-(g:Gene) RETURN m.ENTITY AS mesh_entity, count(DISTINCT g) AS gene_count
How many papers mention LINC00954?
MATCH (:Gene {ENTITY:'LINC00954'})-[:HAS_SOURCE]->(l:Literature) RETURN count(DISTINCT l) AS paper_count
Genes co-occurring with Urolithiasis after 2023.
MATCH (:MeSH {ENTITY:'Urolithiasis'})<-[:CO_OCCURS]-(g:Gene)-[:HAS_SOURCE]->(l:Literature) WHERE l.Year > 2023 RETURN DISTINCT g.ENTITY AS gene_entity
Genes that share at least one MeSH with LINC00954.
MATCH (g1:Gene {ENTITY:'LINC00954'})-[:CO_OCCURS]-(m:MeSH)-[:CO_OCCURS]-(g2:Gene) WHERE g1 <> g2 RETURN DISTINCT g2.ENTITY AS gene_entity
Common MeSH of LINC00954 and TP53.
MATCH (:Gene {ENTITY:'LINC00954'})-[:CO_OCCURS]-(m:MeSH)-[:CO_OCCURS]-(:Gene {ENTITY:'TP53'}) RETURN DISTINCT m.ENTITY AS mesh_entity
Papers mentioning both LINC00954 and Urolithiasis.
MATCH (:Gene {ENTITY:'LINC00954'})-[:HAS_SOURCE]->(l:Literature)<-[:HAS_SOURCE]-(:MeSH {ENTITY:'Urolithiasis'}) RETURN DISTINCT l.PMID AS pmid
Does LINC00954 co-occur with Urolithiasis?
MATCH (:Gene {ENTITY:'LINC00954'})-[:CO_OCCURS]-(:MeSH {ENTITY:'Urolithiasis'}) RETURN count(*) > 0 AS exists
Papers that have a PMID.
MATCH (l:Literature) WHERE l.PMID IS NOT NULL RETURN l.PMID AS pmid
Distinct journals for Urolithiasis-related genes.
MATCH (:MeSH {ENTITY:'Urolithiasis'})<-[:CO_OCCURS]-(g:Gene)-[:HAS_SOURCE]->(l:Literature) RETURN DISTINCT l.Journal AS journal
Find all papers mentioning the following genes: Gm3183, Svs4, Gm49638.
MATCH (g:Gene)-[:HAS_SOURCE]->(l:Literature) WHERE g.ENTITY IN ["Gm3183", "Svs4", "Gm49638"] RETURN DISTINCT l.PMID AS pmid
Find all papers mentioning the following MeSH entitys: Dryopteris/drug, Helminthosporium/virology, Dibenzoxazepines/instrumentation.
MATCH (m:MeSH)-[:HAS_SOURCE]->(l:Literature) WHERE m.ENTITY IN ["Dryopteris/drug", "Helminthosporium/virology", "Dibenzoxazepines/instrumentation"] RETURN DISTINCT l.PMID AS pmid
Find all genes and MeSH reported in the paper with PMID 77416376.
MATCH (l:Literature {PMID: '77416376'})<-[:HAS_SOURCE]-(e) WHERE e:Gene OR e:MeSH RETURN DISTINCT e.ENTITY AS entity
Find all genes reported in the paper with PMID 77416376.
MATCH (l:Literature {PMID: '77416376'})<-[:HAS_SOURCE]-(g:Gene) RETURN DISTINCT g.ENTITY AS gene_entity
Find all MeSH entitys reported in the paper with PMID 77416376.
MATCH (l:Literature {PMID: '77416376'})<-[:HAS_SOURCE]-(m:MeSH) RETURN DISTINCT m.ENTITY AS mesh_entity
Find all papers that report MeSH containing the word 'immun'.
MATCH (m:MeSH)-[:HAS_SOURCE]->(l:Literature) WHERE toLower(m.ENTITY) CONTAINS toLower('immun') RETURN DISTINCT l.PMID AS pmid
Find all papers that report MeSH containing the word 'immun', and return the MeSH entitys too.
MATCH (m:MeSH)-[:HAS_SOURCE]->(l:Literature) WHERE toLower(m.ENTITY) CONTAINS toLower('immun') RETURN DISTINCT l.PMID AS pmid, m.ENTITY AS mesh_entity
Find all papers that report LINC00954.
MATCH (:Gene {ENTITY:'LINC00954'})-[:HAS_SOURCE]->(l:Literature) RETURN DISTINCT l.PMID AS pmid
Find all papers that report LINC00954 and return those papers, LINC00954, and other co-occurring genes.
MATCH (g:Gene {ENTITY:'LINC00954'})-[:HAS_SOURCE]->(l:Literature)<-[:HAS_SOURCE]-(g2:Gene) RETURN DISTINCT l.PMID AS pmid, g.ENTITY AS gene_entity, g2.ENTITY AS co_gene_entity
Find all papers that report LINC00954 and return those papers, LINC00954, and other co-occurring MeSH entitys.
MATCH (g:Gene {ENTITY:'LINC00954'})-[:HAS_SOURCE]->(l:Literature)<-[:HAS_SOURCE]-(m:MeSH) RETURN DISTINCT l.PMID AS pmid, g.ENTITY AS gene_entity, m.ENTITY AS mesh_entity
Find all papers that report LINC00954 and return those papers, LINC00954, and other co-occurring entities.
MATCH (g:Gene {ENTITY:'LINC00954'})-[:HAS_SOURCE]->(l:Literature)<-[:HAS_SOURCE]-(e) WHERE e:Gene OR e:MeSH RETURN DISTINCT l.PMID AS pmid, g.ENTITY AS gene_entity, e.ENTITY AS co_entity
Find all publications after 2020 where genes co-occur with MeSH entitys containing 'neurology'.

MATCH (p:Literature)<-[:HAS_SOURCE]-(g:Gene)-[:CO_OCCURS]-(m:MeSH) WHERE p.Year > 2020 AND toLower(m.ENTITY) CONTAINS toLower('neurology') RETURN DISTINCT p.PMID AS pmid, g.ENTITY AS gene_entity, m.ENTITY AS mesh_entity
Does LINC00954 directly co-occur with Gm32220?
MATCH (:Gene {ENTITY:'LINC00954'})-[:CO_OCCURS]-(:Gene {ENTITY:'Gm32220'}) RETURN count(*) > 0 AS exists
Find papers that mention both LINC00954 and Gm32220.
MATCH (:Gene {ENTITY:'LINC00954'})-[:HAS_SOURCE]->(l:Literature)<-[:HAS_SOURCE]-(:Gene {ENTITY:'Gm32220'}) RETURN DISTINCT l.PMID AS pmid
Find MeSH entitys shared by LINC00954 and Gm32220.
MATCH (:Gene {ENTITY:'LINC00954'})-[:CO_OCCURS]-(m:MeSH)-[:CO_OCCURS]-(:Gene {ENTITY:'Gm32220'}) RETURN DISTINCT m.ENTITY AS mesh_entity
Count MeSH entitys shared by LINC00954 and Gm32220.
MATCH (:Gene {ENTITY:'LINC00954'})-[:CO_OCCURS]-(m:MeSH)-[:CO_OCCURS]-(:Gene {ENTITY:'Gm32220'}) RETURN count(DISTINCT m) AS shared_mesh_count
Find genes that share MeSH entitys with LINC00954.
MATCH (g1:Gene {ENTITY:'LINC00954'})-[:CO_OCCURS]-(m:MeSH)-[:CO_OCCURS]-(g2:Gene) WHERE g1 <> g2 RETURN DISTINCT g2.ENTITY AS gene_entity
Find papers of genes that share MeSH entitys with LINC00954.
MATCH (g1:Gene {ENTITY:'LINC00954'})-[:CO_OCCURS]-(m:MeSH)-[:CO_OCCURS]-(g2:Gene)-[:HAS_SOURCE]->(l:Literature) WHERE g1 <> g2 RETURN DISTINCT g2.ENTITY AS gene_entity, l.PMID AS pmid
Find papers after 2017 of genes that share MeSH entitys with LINC00954.

MATCH (g1:Gene {ENTITY:'LINC00954'})-[:CO_OCCURS]-(m:MeSH)-[:CO_OCCURS]-(g2:Gene)-[:HAS_SOURCE]->(l:Literature) WHERE g1 <> g2 AND l.Year > 2017 RETURN DISTINCT g2.ENTITY AS gene_entity, l.PMID AS pmid
Find journals for papers of genes sharing MeSH entitys with LINC00954.
MATCH (g1:Gene {ENTITY:'LINC00954'})-[:CO_OCCURS]-(m:MeSH)-[:CO_OCCURS]-(g2:Gene)-[:HAS_SOURCE]->(l:Literature) WHERE g1 <> g2 RETURN DISTINCT l.Journal AS journal
Count genes that share MeSH entitys with LINC00954.
MATCH (g1:Gene {ENTITY:'LINC00954'})-[:CO_OCCURS]-(m:MeSH)-[:CO_OCCURS]-(g2:Gene) WHERE g1 <> g2 RETURN count(DISTINCT g2) AS gene_count
Find MeSH entitys connected to genes that share MeSH entitys with LINC00954.
MATCH (g1:Gene {ENTITY:'LINC00954'})-[:CO_OCCURS]-(:MeSH)-[:CO_OCCURS]-(g2:Gene)-[:CO_OCCURS]-(m2:MeSH) WHERE g1 <> g2 RETURN DISTINCT m2.ENTITY AS mesh_entity
Find papers about genes related to MeSH Urolithiasis.
MATCH (:MeSH {ENTITY:'Urolithiasis'})-[:CO_OCCURS]-(g:Gene)-[:HAS_SOURCE]->(l:Literature) RETURN DISTINCT g.ENTITY AS gene_entity, l.PMID AS pmid
Find Science papers about genes related to MeSH Urolithiasis.
MATCH (:MeSH {ENTITY:'Urolithiasis'})-[:CO_OCCURS]-(g:Gene)-[:HAS_SOURCE]->(l:Literature) WHERE l.Journal = 'Science' RETURN DISTINCT g.ENTITY AS gene_entity, l.PMID AS pmid
Find papers whose title contains 'metabolism' about genes related to MeSH Urolithiasis.
MATCH (:MeSH {ENTITY:'Urolithiasis'})-[:CO_OCCURS]-(g:Gene)-[:HAS_SOURCE]->(l:Literature) WHERE toLower(l.Title) CONTAINS toLower('metabolism') RETURN DISTINCT g.ENTITY AS gene_entity, l.PMID AS pmid
Count genes related to MeSH Urolithiasis.
MATCH (:MeSH {ENTITY:'Urolithiasis'})-[:CO_OCCURS]-(g:Gene) RETURN count(DISTINCT g) AS gene_count
Find genes related to both MeSH Urolithiasis and MeSH Mole.
MATCH (:MeSH {ENTITY:'Urolithiasis'})-[:CO_OCCURS]-(g:Gene)-[:CO_OCCURS]-(:MeSH {ENTITY:'Mole'}) RETURN DISTINCT g.ENTITY AS gene_entity
Find papers for genes related to both MeSH Urolithiasis and MeSH Mole.
MATCH (:MeSH {ENTITY:'Urolithiasis'})-[:CO_OCCURS]-(g:Gene)-[:CO_OCCURS]-(:MeSH {ENTITY:'Mole'}) MATCH (g)-[:HAS_SOURCE]->(l:Literature) RETURN DISTINCT g.ENTITY AS gene_entity, l.PMID AS pmid
Find papers after 2013 that mention both LINC00954 and MeSH Urolithiasis.
MATCH (:Gene {ENTITY:'LINC00954'})-[:HAS_SOURCE]->(l:Literature)<-[:HAS_SOURCE]-(:MeSH {ENTITY:'Urolithiasis'}) WHERE l.Year > 2013 RETURN DISTINCT l.PMID AS pmid
Find Science papers that mention both LINC00954 and MeSH Urolithiasis.
MATCH (:Gene {ENTITY:'LINC00954'})-[:HAS_SOURCE]->(l:Literature)<-[:HAS_SOURCE]-(:MeSH {ENTITY:'Urolithiasis'}) WHERE l.Journal = 'Science' RETURN DISTINCT l.PMID AS pmid
Find papers whose title contains 'metabolism' and mention both LINC00954 and MeSH Urolithiasis.
MATCH (:Gene {ENTITY:'LINC00954'})-[:HAS_SOURCE]->(l:Literature)<-[:HAS_SOURCE]-(:MeSH {ENTITY:'Urolithiasis'}) WHERE toLower(l.Title) CONTAINS toLower('metabolism') RETURN DISTINCT l.PMID AS pmid
Count papers that mention both LINC00954 and MeSH Urolithiasis.
MATCH (:Gene {ENTITY:'LINC00954'})-[:HAS_SOURCE]->(l:Literature)<-[:HAS_SOURCE]-(:MeSH {ENTITY:'Urolithiasis'}) RETURN count(DISTINCT l) AS paper_count
Does any paper mention both LINC00954 and MeSH Urolithiasis?
MATCH (:Gene {ENTITY:'LINC00954'})-[:HAS_SOURCE]->(l:Literature)<-[:HAS_SOURCE]-(:MeSH {ENTITY:'Urolithiasis'}) RETURN count(DISTINCT l) > 0 AS exists
Find genes in the paper with PMID 55440919 that also co-occur with MeSH Urolithiasis.
MATCH (l:Literature {PMID:'55440919'})<-[:HAS_SOURCE]-(g:Gene)-[:CO_OCCURS]-(:MeSH {ENTITY:'Urolithiasis'}) RETURN DISTINCT g.ENTITY AS gene_entity
Find MeSH entitys in the paper with PMID 55440919 that also co-occur with LINC00954.
MATCH (l:Literature {PMID:'55440919'})<-[:HAS_SOURCE]-(m:MeSH)-[:CO_OCCURS]-(:Gene {ENTITY:'LINC00954'}) RETURN DISTINCT m.ENTITY AS mesh_entity
Find gene and MeSH pairs reported in the paper with PMID 55440919.
MATCH (g:Gene)-[:HAS_SOURCE]->(l:Literature {PMID:'55440919'})<-[:HAS_SOURCE]-(m:MeSH) RETURN DISTINCT g.ENTITY AS gene_entity, m.ENTITY AS mesh_entity
Find papers mentioning any of these genes and MeSH Urolithiasis: NRSN2, Gm15807, miR-548ba.
MATCH (g:Gene)-[:HAS_SOURCE]->(l:Literature)<-[:HAS_SOURCE]-(:MeSH {ENTITY:'Urolithiasis'}) WHERE g.ENTITY IN ['NRSN2', 'Gm15807', 'miR-548ba'] RETURN DISTINCT g.ENTITY AS gene_entity, l.PMID AS pmid
Find genes co-occurring with any of these MeSH entitys: Green/anatomy, Amdinocillin, Syndactyly/supply.
MATCH (g:Gene)-[:CO_OCCURS]-(m:MeSH) WHERE m.ENTITY IN ['Green/anatomy', 'Amdinocillin', 'Syndactyly/supply'] RETURN DISTINCT g.ENTITY AS gene_entity
Find papers for genes co-occurring with any of these MeSH entitys: Green/anatomy, Amdinocillin, Syndactyly/supply.

MATCH (g:Gene)-[:CO_OCCURS]-(m:MeSH) WHERE m.ENTITY IN ['Green/anatomy', 'Amdinocillin', 'Syndactyly/supply'] MATCH (g)-[:HAS_SOURCE]->(l:Literature) RETURN DISTINCT g.ENTITY AS gene_entity, l.PMID AS pmid
Find papers where MeSH contains 'oncolog' and genes are reported after 2017.

MATCH (m:MeSH)-[:HAS_SOURCE]->(l:Literature)<-[:HAS_SOURCE]-(g:Gene) WHERE toLower(m.ENTITY) CONTAINS toLower('oncolog') AND l.Year > 2017 RETURN DISTINCT l.PMID AS pmid, g.ENTITY AS gene_entity, m.ENTITY AS mesh_entity
Find MeSH pairs connected through gene LINC00954.
MATCH (:MeSH)-[:CO_OCCURS]-(g:Gene {ENTITY:'LINC00954'})-[:CO_OCCURS]-(m2:MeSH) RETURN DISTINCT m2.ENTITY AS mesh_entity

MATCH (g:Gene)-[:CO_OCCURS]-(m:MeSH) WHERE m.ENTITY IN ['Mytilus', 'Bender-Gestalt', 'Infradian/congenital'] RETURN DISTINCT g.ENTITY AS gene_entity
Find papers for genes co-occurring with any of these MeSH entitys: Mytilus, Bender-Gestalt, Infradian/congenital.

MATCH (g:Gene)-[:CO_OCCURS]-(m:MeSH) WHERE m.ENTITY IN ['Mytilus', 'Bender-Gestalt', 'Infradian/congenital'] MATCH (g)-[:HAS_SOURCE]->(l:Literature) RETURN DISTINCT g.ENTITY AS gene_entity, l.PMID AS pmid
Find papers where MeSH contains 'metab' and genes are reported after 2017.

MATCH (m:MeSH)-[:HAS_SOURCE]->(l:Literature)<-[:HAS_SOURCE]-(g:Gene) WHERE toLower(m.ENTITY) CONTAINS toLower('metab') AND l.Year > 2017 RETURN DISTINCT l.PMID AS pmid, g.ENTITY AS gene_entity, m.ENTITY AS mesh_entity
Find MeSH pairs connected through gene Gm14994.
MATCH (:MeSH)-[:CO_OCCURS]-(g:Gene {ENTITY:'Gm14994'})-[:CO_OCCURS]-(m2:MeSH) RETURN DISTINCT m2.ENTITY AS mesh_entity
Find genes connected to Gm14994 through MeSH Dinoprostone.
MATCH (:Gene {ENTITY:'Gm14994'})-[:CO_OCCURS]-(:MeSH {ENTITY:'Dinoprostone'})-[:CO_OCCURS]-(g2:Gene) RETURN DISTINCT g2.ENTITY AS gene_entity
Find papers of genes connected to Gm14994 through MeSH Dinoprostone.
MATCH (:Gene {ENTITY:'Gm14994'})-[:CO_OCCURS]-(:MeSH {ENTITY:'Dinoprostone'})-[:CO_OCCURS]-(g2:Gene)-[:HAS_SOURCE]->(l:Literature) RETURN DISTINCT g2.ENTITY AS gene_entity, l.PMID AS pmid
List all genes.
MATCH (g:Gene) RETURN g.ENTITY AS gene_entity
List all MeSH entitys.
MATCH (m:MeSH) RETURN m.ENTITY AS mesh_entity
List literature nodes.
MATCH (l:Literature) RETURN l.PMID AS pmid
Find MeSH entitys co-occurring with Gm37841.
MATCH (:Gene {ENTITY:'Gm37841'})-[:CO_OCCURS]-(m:MeSH) RETURN DISTINCT m.ENTITY AS mesh_entity
Which genes co-occur with the MeSH entity Mole?
MATCH (g:Gene)-[:CO_OCCURS]-(:MeSH {ENTITY:'Mole'}) RETURN DISTINCT g.ENTITY AS gene_entity
Show literature linked to Gm37841.
MATCH (:Gene {ENTITY:'Gm37841'})-[:HAS_SOURCE]->(l:Literature) RETURN DISTINCT l.PMID AS pmid
Show literature for MeSH Mole.
MATCH (:MeSH {ENTITY:'Mole'})-[:HAS_SOURCE]->(l:Literature) RETURN DISTINCT l.PMID AS pmid
Papers whose title contains 'genome'.
MATCH (l:Literature) WHERE toLower(l.Title) CONTAINS toLower('genome') RETURN l.PMID AS pmid
Gm37841 papers after 2024.
MATCH (:Gene {ENTITY:'Gm37841'})-[:HAS_SOURCE]->(l:Literature) WHERE l.Year > 2024 RETURN DISTINCT l.PMID AS pmid
Gm37841 papers in BMJ.
MATCH (:Gene {ENTITY:'Gm37841'})-[:HAS_SOURCE]->(l:Literature) WHERE l.Journal = 'BMJ' RETURN DISTINCT l.PMID AS pmid
Count MeSH entitys per gene.
MATCH (g:Gene)-[:CO_OCCURS]-(m:MeSH) RETURN g.ENTITY AS gene_entity, count(DISTINCT m) AS mesh_count
Count genes per MeSH entity.
MATCH (m:MeSH)<-[:CO_OCCURS]-(g:Gene) RETURN m.ENTITY AS mesh_entity, count(DISTINCT g) AS gene_count
How many papers mention Gm37841?
MATCH (:Gene {ENTITY:'Gm37841'})-[:HAS_SOURCE]->(l:Literature) RETURN count(DISTINCT l) AS paper_count
Genes co-occurring with Mole after 2004.
MATCH (:MeSH {ENTITY:'Mole'})<-[:CO_OCCURS]-(g:Gene)-[:HAS_SOURCE]->(l:Literature) WHERE l.Year > 2004 RETURN DISTINCT g.ENTITY AS gene_entity
Genes that share at least one MeSH with Gm37841.
MATCH (g1:Gene {ENTITY:'Gm37841'})-[:CO_OCCURS]-(m:MeSH)-[:CO_OCCURS]-(g2:Gene) WHERE g1 <> g2 RETURN DISTINCT g2.ENTITY AS gene_entity
Common MeSH of Gm37841 and TP53.
MATCH (:Gene {ENTITY:'Gm37841'})-[:CO_OCCURS]-(m:MeSH)-[:CO_OCCURS]-(:Gene {ENTITY:'TP53'}) RETURN DISTINCT m.ENTITY AS mesh_entity
Papers mentioning both Gm37841 and Mole.
MATCH (:Gene {ENTITY:'Gm37841'})-[:HAS_SOURCE]->(l:Literature)<-[:HAS_SOURCE]-(:MeSH {ENTITY:'Mole'}) RETURN DISTINCT l.PMID AS pmid
Does Gm37841 co-occur with Mole?
MATCH (:Gene {ENTITY:'Gm37841'})-[:CO_OCCURS]-(:MeSH {ENTITY:'Mole'}) RETURN count(*) > 0 AS exists
Papers that have a PMID.
MATCH (l:Literature) WHERE l.PMID IS NOT NULL RETURN l.PMID AS pmid
Distinct journals for Mole-related genes.
MATCH (:MeSH {ENTITY:'Mole'})<-[:CO_OCCURS]-(g:Gene)-[:HAS_SOURCE]->(l:Literature) RETURN DISTINCT l.Journal AS journal
Find all papers mentioning the following genes: LINC00385, SLC10A4, Gm8357.
MATCH (g:Gene)-[:HAS_SOURCE]->(l:Literature) WHERE g.ENTITY IN ["LINC00385", "SLC10A4", "Gm8357"] RETURN DISTINCT l.PMID AS pmid
Find all papers mentioning the following MeSH entitys: Agnosia, Slovenia/therapeutic, Caulimovirus.
MATCH (m:MeSH)-[:HAS_SOURCE]->(l:Literature) WHERE m.ENTITY IN ["Agnosia", "Slovenia/therapeutic", "Caulimovirus"] RETURN DISTINCT l.PMID AS pmid
Find all genes and MeSH reported in the paper with PMID 96519508.
MATCH (l:Literature {PMID: '96519508'})<-[:HAS_SOURCE]-(e) WHERE e:Gene OR e:MeSH RETURN DISTINCT e.ENTITY AS entity
